paper_title: Discovering QCD-Coupled Axion Dark Matter with Polarization Haloscopes
suggested_experiment_name: Polarization Haloscope (Berlin & Zhou) - existing Sun/SN1987A constraints
notes: This is a projection/proposal paper for a 'polarization haloscope' targeting the QCD axion-gluon coupling. The main exclusion plot (Fig. 2) has 1/f_a (GeV^-1) on the y-axis vs m_a (eV) on the x-axis, NOT a standard photon, electron, or EDM coupling. This corresponds most closely to AxionMass-type (f_a vs m_a) parameterization, but the y-axis is the inverse decay constant 1/f_a rather than a conventional coupling constant. The axion-gluon coupling probed relates to oscillating nuclear/atomic EDMs (axion-EDM physics), so the pre-analysis hint of AxionEDM is conceptually related, but the actual plotted quantity is 1/f_a, not d_n in e*cm. No numerical table of (mass, 1/f_a) limit points is given; sensitivity is shown only as shaded curves in Fig. 2. Therefore no reliable data points can be extracted.
